resourceProfile.assessment: Comparative screening of all remaining locales selected European Portuguese for repeated protected-unit corruption, mistranslated battery notes and product identity. Full review covered 1115 canonical entries, optional hooks, catalog nouns, glossary and route metadata. Primary Portuguese terminology checked against IPQ SI references; existing canonical numerical claims retained. Resources: AGENTS.md; skills/steam-engine-improve-translations/SKILL.md; skills/_shared/i18n-translation-contract.md; .build-runs/translation-screening/entries.json; src/i18n/glossaries/pt.json; src/i18n/locales.ts; src/i18n/mod-comparison-metadata.ts; src/shared/ui/catalog-manager.tsx; src/catalogs/materials/material-editor.tsx; src/pages/ohm/ohm-calculator.tsx; src/pages/wirewiz/wire-wizard.tsx; src/pages/tcr/tcr-calculator.tsx; https://www.ipq.pt/metrologia/medicoes-dominios-intervencao/areas-atividade/eletricidade-magnetismo/; https://www.ipq.pt/metrologia/sistema-internacional-de-unidades/; https://diariodarepublica.pt/dr/detalhe/decreto-lei/76-2020-143741481
limitations: Comparative screening is not an exhaustive global ranking.
Model critique is not competent human review.
Shared application strings outside locale dictionaries are documented separately; no unrelated multi-locale architecture changes.
Machine linguistic critique, not native-speaker or human approval.
Catalog research records and user-created names are not translatable dictionary entries; names are preserved.
Hardcoded shared JSX outside existing optional hooks requires a separate shared i18n task.
Canonical English defects are recorded separately; target display escape repairs are independently actionable.
Decimal comma is equivalent to decimal point and does not change numeric values.
Valid resistance/bobina variants and existing valid metadata were retained.
The glossary output-power entry was previously needs-review; correction is a terminology disagreement backed by electrical quantity and JSX output context.
Existing liquid-calculator mobile document overflow is caused by offscreen sr-only inputs; the same 548px width occurs in English at a 390px viewport. Visible controls fit; shared layout unchanged.

automatedQuality.summary: All 573 tests in 85 files passed after updating the Portuguese review-state expectation and running tests after builds to avoid deployment-lock contention. Typecheck, metadata check, all 1115 runtime signatures, preserved numbers/placeholders, six changed catalog consumers, full IIS and Cloudflare builds, 64 route cases and 737 links in 10279 HTML files passed. Browser checked 15 Portuguese pages and three catalog editors plus four desktop/mobile layouts. All 13 Portuguese route pages have balanced script/div tags and pt-PT language metadata. Cloudflare artifact has Worker and 404 files and no IIS configuration.

linguisticCritique.summary: All 1115 canonical entries, 13 route metadata records, 11 glossary entries, 8 optional hooks and 17 category functions reviewed; 174 display entries and one glossary entry corrected in 56 cause groups, plus six known category noun mappings.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent European Portuguese human review performed; existing unaffected approval attribution preserved, changed text returned to machine review.

publicationAuthorization.summary: User requested review, improvement, commit, push and deployment.

findings.summary: [battery-pack-meaning] Pack means an electrical assembly of cells, not a package of mods. Preserve both discharge-limit conditions and nominal/measured dimensions.
evidence: English: Enter at least one continuous discharge limit. Integrated batteries are internal mod packs, so standalone cell dimensions are not required. Removable-cell dimensions are nominal; use the notes for measured as-sold dimensions. When both discharge limits are set, the calculator continues to use the safer derived limit if they differ materially.

Previous European Portuguese: Introduza pelo menos um limite de descarga contínua. As baterias integradas são pacotes de mod internos, pelo que não são necessárias dimensões de células independentes. As dimensões das células amovíveis são nominais; utilize as notas para as dimensões medidas conforme vendidas. Quando ambos os limites de descarga são definidos, a calculadora continua a utilizar o limite derivado mais seguro se estes diferirem materialmente.
findings.resolution: Introduza pelo menos um limite de descarga contínua. As baterias integradas são conjuntos de células internos do mod, pelo que não são necessárias dimensões de células independentes. As dimensões das células amovíveis são nominais; utilize as notas para as dimensões medidas da bateria tal como é vendida. Quando ambos os limites de descarga estão definidos, a calculadora continua a utilizar o limite derivado mais seguro se estes diferirem significativamente.

evidence: English: Ohm's law combines with the power relationship P = V × I. Power P is measured in watts (W). For a 4.2 V source and a 1.0 Ω load, the ideal power is 17.64 W. The component needs enough thermal capacity and headroom to dissipate the resulting heat safely.

findings.resolution: A lei de Ohm combina com a relação de potência P = V × I. A potência P é medida em watts (W). Para uma fonte de 4,2 V e uma carga de 1,0 Ω, a potência ideal é de 17,64 W. findings.summary: [gauge-system] Gauge is a named wire-size scale, not a counter or instrument; naming means identify the existing system.
evidence: English: Resistance depends on conductor length L, cross-sectional area A, and material resistivity ρ. Because area varies with the square of diameter, a modest diameter difference can make a substantial resistance difference. In AWG, increasing the gauge by three sizes approximately halves area and doubles resistance per unit length for the same material and temperature.

Previous European Portuguese: A resistência depende do comprimento do condutor L, da área da secção transversal A e da resistividade do material ρ. Como a área varia com o quadrado do diâmetro, uma diferença modesta no diâmetro pode causar uma diferença substancial na resistência. No AWG, o aumento do medidor em três tamanhos reduz aproximadamente a área para metade e duplica a resistência por unidade de comprimento para o mesmo material e temperatura.
findings.resolution: A resistência depende do comprimento do condutor L, da área da secção transversal A e da resistividade do material ρ. Como a área varia com o quadrado do diâmetro, uma diferença modesta no diâmetro pode causar uma diferença substancial na resistência.
